adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(...) } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which drops the actual `err` details and any context like `bookingId`. This doesn’t directly break the add-guests flow (it still returns success), but it degrades observability/debuggability of real email failures as the finding describes.
